transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I don’t care about the projects and hobbies I used to love anymore; nothing feels interesting to me now. I used to be so active with different things, but lately, I just can't find the spark to do any of it.
Can you tell me when you first started feeling this way and if it's been constant since then or if your feelings about these activities have changed over time?

It started a little over a year ago when I lost a major solar contract and the financial stress got really bad, and it's been constant ever since. My passion for things like painting, improv, and hiking has completely vanished. Now, I mostly just sit on the couch or in my truck, feeling absolutely no spark to do any of it.
Have you experienced any significant changes in your appetite or sleep patterns since you lost interest in your hobbies and activities?

Yes, both have been really off. I have to force myself to eat because everything tastes like cardboard, and I'll often realize it's late afternoon and I've only had a few crackers. At night, I lie awake for hours worrying about bills, and then I wake up at three or four in the morning exhausted but unable to fall back asleep.

Can you describe how your feelings of sadness or hopelessness have changed over the past year, and have you had any periods where you felt significantly better or back to normal for a couple of months before worsening again?

Pretty much every day for a little over a year, I've had this heavy, sinking feeling in my chest that just hangs over me from morning till night. I haven't had any periods where I felt back to normal or even slightly better; it has just been a continuous, chronic struggle since I lost that contract.

Have you experienced any episodes of significant improvement in your mood or interest in activities that lasted for at least two months since the onset of your symptoms, or has it been a persistent state?

No, it has been a completely persistent state without any breaks or improvement. Ever since I lost that solar contract about a year ago, this heavy mood and lack of interest have been there every single day. There hasn't been any time, let alone two months, where things felt back to normal.

You've described a persistent state of low mood and loss of interest for over a year without significant improvement, but can you tell me if there have been any periods, even brief, where your symptoms seemed to worsen or if they've remained fairly constant in intensity?

While it has mostly felt like a constant, heavy fog over the past year, it definitely gets much worse on certain nights. It feels especially overwhelming when I'm sitting alone, staring at the stack of overdue bills and notices. Those are the times when the weight of everything really crushes me.

Can you describe if there are any specific times of the year, seasons, or events that trigger a noticeable change in your mood or interest levels, even if it's just a slight variation from your usual state?

I haven't really noticed any seasonal patterns or times of the year that make a difference in how I feel. The only real trigger for all of this was losing that major solar contract and the constant financial stress that followed. It has just been a steady weight since then, regardless of the season.
Have you experienced any episodes of depression in the past that lasted for less than two years, or is this the first time you've felt this way for such an extended period?

No, I’ve never really experienced anything like this before. This is definitely the first time I’ve felt this way for such a long period of time. Before this past year, I was always able to handle stress and keep moving forward.

Have you had any previous episodes of depression that were shorter in duration, or is this the first episode you've experienced, and if so, how does it compare to your current state in terms of severity and impact on daily life?

This is the absolute first time I've ever experienced an episode of depression like this. I've never had any shorter episodes in the past, so I don't have anything to compare it to. It's completely new to me and has totally disrupted my life.

You mentioned this is your first episode of depression, but can you confirm if you've had any periods of elevated mood or excessive energy that lasted for a few days to a week, where you felt unusually happy, irritable, or had less need for sleep, either before or during this current episode?
I don't think I've ever had periods like that at all. My mood has mostly just been consistently low, heavy, and exhausted, rather than unusually high or energetic.

Given that you've experienced this persistent low mood and loss of interest for over a year without any significant improvement, can you confirm whether you believe this is a single, continuous episode of depression or if you think there might have been any subtle variations that could suggest more than one episode?

It has definitely felt like one single, continuous struggle without any breaks. Ever since I lost the big solar contract and the financial pressure set in, it has just been one long, unbroken stretch of feeling like this. There haven't been any periods where things got better or felt different.

You've confirmed this is your first episode of depression, lasting over a year without significant improvement. Can you think of any factors or events that might have contributed to the persistence of your symptoms, rather than a more episodic course?

The financial stress just hasn't let up at all, which is why I think it's been so constant. Since losing that contract, I've been drowning in outstanding equipment loans and irregular income, all while constantly worrying that I'll have to sell my tools or downsize my home. The pressure is there every single day, so I never get a break from it.

You've described a single, continuous episode of depression lasting over a year. Can you confirm if you've experienced any brief periods, even just a few weeks, where you felt nearly back to your normal self before the depressive symptoms returned?

No, I haven't had even a brief period of feeling like myself again. It has been a continuous, heavy struggle every single day for the past year since my business stalled, with absolutely no relief. It just feels like one long, unbroken weight.

You've had a continuous episode of depression for over a year without significant improvement, but can you tell me if you've had any brief periods of feeling slightly better, even if it was just for a few days, or has it been a completely unbroken period of depressive symptoms?

No, it has been completely unbroken with no relief at all. Ever since I lost the solar contract, every single day has felt heavy and difficult. I haven't had even a few days where I felt slightly better.

Given that you've experienced this continuous episode of depression for over a year without any periods of significant improvement, can you clarify if you believe the severity of your symptoms has remained constant or if there have been any subtle fluctuations, even if the overall state has been one of persistent depression?

While the heavy, depressed feeling has been a constant presence for a little over a year, there are definitely fluctuations where it gets significantly worse. Specifically, on the nights when I'm staring at the stack of overdue bills and notices, it becomes much more intense and makes me feel even more overwhelmed and hopeless. Those are the times when the weight of everything really crashes down on me.
